w: Rewards for returning a Juvinate to human form

Overloads (3) (unfinished) are partially-made overload potions, made by Granny Rowan with a tier 3 Botanist's Workbench constructed in Fort Forinthry.

Small XP lamp (2017 Valentine's Day even.x: Small XP lamps are available from the second half of the 2017 Valentine's Day event. One is earned by shooing away each of the Devotion Sprites while wearing the Devotion Sprite costume.

tx:
Prior to completing 'Phite Club, using the "Locate" function results in the message: "The talisman doesn't seem to work, maybe the ruins are deep underground." After completion of the quest the talisman will pull you in the direction of a fountain in the south-west corner of the imperial district of Menaphos. Using the soul talisman on the fountain will drain the fountain of its water revealing the entrance to the soul altar.
Using the talisman on the map in the Runecrafting Guild reveals the altar is "Located within the walls of Menaphos." However, as that map existed long before Menaphos' release, it does not include the city, and erroneously points to the location of Heart of Gielinor.
sc: The soul talisman, and thus soul runecrafting, was released on 5 June 2017 as a drop from feline and imperial guard akhs in the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon.
It may also be obtained from looting sarcophagi in Shifting Tombs.
It can be created by combining an orb of corrupted anima, orb of volcanic anima, and orb of pure anima with a dormant staff of Sliske, all of which are dropped by Telos, the Warden.
